description: The newest recorded order book of one Predict.fun market, priced on its first outcome (Yes): `bids` highest first and `asks` lowest first as [price, quantity], orders matched but not yet settled (`pending_*`), the last settled order, `ts` (Predict.fun's time) and `recorded_ts` (ours), epoch ms. Books are recorded for the ~1,000 most active open markets; none in 30 days is an error.

market_id.description: The Predict.fun market id (`market_id` from predictfun_markets). Required.

name: predictfun_market_book
title: Predict.fun Market Book
